relationships.subject: METTL3
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings suggest that METTL3 expression is diminished in SNL and that METTL3 positively regulates SOCS1 expression.

relationships.subject: METTL3
relationships.evidence_quote: METTL3 knockdown markedly reduced m6A modification of SOCS1 mRNA

relationships.subject: SOCS1
relationships.evidence_quote: MT can mitigate NP by enhancing SOCS1 expression and suppressing the stimulation of the TLR4 signaling cascade.

relationships.subject: manipulation therapy
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings suggest that MT can enhance METTL3 expression in the spinal cord of rat SNL models, thereby restoring overall m6A methylation levels.

relationships.subject: METTL3
relationships.evidence_quote: METTL3 reduction led to elevated levels of inflammatory factors TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6

relationships.subject: manipulation therapy
relationships.evidence_quote: MT treatment effectively restored the protein levels of METTL3, YTHDF1, and FTO (Fig. 4B).

key_findings: Manipulation therapy relieves SNL neuropathic pain by restoring spinal METTL3 and SOCS1 mRNA m6A methylation, which raises SOCS1 and suppresses TLR4 signaling and TNF-α/IL-1β/IL-6.
METTL3 knockdown worsened pain hypersensitivity and inflammation and lowered SOCS1.
